title: Nahum
author: Nahum the Elkoshite.
date: Seventh century B.C., before Nineveh's fall in 612 B.C.
audience: Judah, comforting them with God's judgment on Assyria.
historicalSetting: Nahum announces the fall of Nineveh and reveals the Lord as just, powerful, and a refuge for His people.
keyVerse: Nahum 1:7 — "Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble."
christFocus: Nahum points to Christ by displaying God's justice against evil and refuge for those who trust Him.
outline: The Lord's character and judgment — Nahum 1
